title: PacGAN m=8 Packed Critic on 100-Mode Grid
intuition: Packs m=8 samples jointly into the critic D(x_1..x_8) on a 100-mode 10x10 Gaussian grid (sigma=0.05), testing high-order product-measure mode coverage (>= 95/100 modes) and covariance calibration.
failure_mode: Packing increases critic input dimensionality 8x; improperly scaled gradient penalties or weak Law 1 priors still leave collapsed or under-represented modes.
